name: between-boundary-selectivity
description: inclusive and exclusive numeric boundary predicates

queries.name: first-100
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE event_id BETWEEN 1 AND 100

queries.name: midrange-volume
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(quantity) FROM events WHERE amount BETWEEN 1000 AND 9000

queries.name: outside-midrange
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM events WHERE amount NOT BETWEEN 2000 AND 8000
